author: Victor Vance
content: I clocked out at 18:00 and boarded the NightJet sleeper train to Zurich at 20:15. I stayed in Cabin 4B and checked into Zurich Hotel Bellerive at 06:30 the next morning.

author: Hans Weber (Train Conductor)
content: Cabin 4B reserved for Mr. Vance remained vacant when ticket checks occurred at 21:00 and 23:30. A passenger entered only at the Nuremberg stop at 01:45 AM.

author: Marcus Thorne
content: Vance supplied the digital bypass firmware through an encrypted Swiss gateway. He drove his private sedan to Nuremberg after delivering the physical keys to me.
